title: (MAINTENANCE) Scheduled downtime for Promotion APIs
label: TIKTOK SHOP · CHANGELOG
subtitle: Updated 2024-11-22
html:
To support the Black Friday campaign, the Promotion APIs will undergo maintenance and will be temporarily unavailable. Normal operations will resume after the maintenance is complete.

📌 Maintenance schedule: 2024.11.22 06:00 AM - 2024.11.27 06:00 AM (PST)

Affected markets: United States Affected APIs during the maintenance period:

  • Create Activity API
  • Update Activity API
  • Deactivate Activity API
  • Get Activity API
  • Search Activities API
  • Update Activity Product API
  • Remove Activity Product API
  • Get Coupon API
  • Search Coupons API
